propositions: Op-cert service performs per-job boto3/SSM/region lookups and patches process-global state, coupling application config to one secret store and creating concurrency/cleanup hazards.

Application must accept exactly one of REBAR_OPCERT_KEY_PATH or REBAR_OPCERT_PRIVATE_KEY at startup, validate before queue/worker/network/workspace creation, and copy to a process-owned 0700 directory with 0600 file permissions.

Both out-of-opcert_service producer signing chains (completion via transition_close.sign_completion_verdict and plan-review via generation.sign_manifest) must accept and forward an optional context-local OpcertSigner binding, signing from injected binding when supplied by the service and falling back to env/genesis for developer-local callers.

Op-cert application runtime must have no SSM/boto3/region dependency at runtime; the key must be materialized before startup by fetch-secrets.sh to a 0600 file bind-mounted read-only with REBAR_OPCERT_KEY_PATH set.
Process-owned key copy must remain stable for process lifetime, observe replacement only after restart, and cleanup must never alter the deployment source.
Concurrent and timed-out jobs must prove context-local signer/principal/push isolation with one immutable startup signer and no workspace push remote.
